description: ICAO/ISO 2533 Standard Atmosphere (ISA) reference values, computed via acf.science.encyclopedia.aerodynamics.isa_atmosphere.calculate_isa_temperature()/calculate_isa_pressure() - already verified against the published ICAO Doc 7488 / ISO 2533:1975 table to within 0.05% per that module's own NOTE. This golden dataset locks those real values so a future accidental change to the formula or its constants (t0, p0, lapse_rate, g, R) is caught, not silently reintroduced.
